title: Beck Chan
text:
I’m Beck, a poet with a passion for process — helping you empower users by designing and building solutions built to scale.
I’ve designed, implemented, and managed everything from content, support, training, and onboarding architecture for organizations from startups to enterprises.
My methods bridge the gap between product design and user experience, whether that’s advocating for users during early stage development planning, serving as de facto alpha tester and bug fixer extraordinaire, or producing top-quality content that gets users excited about features.

title: curriculum vitae
text:
Took features from design to complete release supported by storytelling alongside software engineers in GitHub.
Improved documentation and training through quality auditing and comprehensive redesigns using Quarto.
Authored 53% of user guidance content, including Jupyter Notebook samples for models and agentic systems.
Bridged gap between product design and user experience, verifying feature functionality and applying bug fixes.
Contributed to CI/CD infrastructure, open-source code libraries and software frontend built on TypeScript.
Designed, standardized, and implemented processes built to scale to close gaps and reduce team workload.
Spearheaded the implementation of an extensible custom Zendesk solution.








Executed migration of evolving support processes to Freshdesk, resulting in a team 100% CSAT satisfaction rate.
Pioneered comprehensive reporting solutions, maintaining systematic report history to identify long-term trends.
Created exhaustive documentation, feedback metrics, and learning curriculums to onboard and train new agents.
Empowered users to understand and maximize the use of products by auditing and overhauling documentation.








Designed and led solo migration of support processes to Zendesk built to scale, increasing efficiency by 74%.
Managed team escalations from complex technical cases, ensuring delivery of solutions to customers.
Proactively identified opportunities for customer growth and product improvements during ticket management.
Provided advanced technical support for web and mobile SDKs built on JavaScript, REST API, and GraphQL.








Streamlined workload by 51% through improvement of implementation processes and onboarding strategies.
Proactively created and maintained public documentation, focusing on accuracy, accessibility, and extensibility.
Produced tangible results for customers by collaborating cross-functionally to deliver custom features.
Designed and executed solutions for custom JavaScript, REST API, and GraphQL software installations.








Led creation of a knowledgebase to empower team members with extensive training and reference materials.
Created a mentorship and feedback program, strengthening team cohesion.
Triaged, escalated, and owned resolution of product bugs for custom installations using Zendesk.








Exceeded target metric expectations at 160% while providing technical support in a fast-paced call center.
Initiated improvements to best practices and processes, including documentation for team knowledgebase.








Multitasked in a fast-paced sales environment to administer and facilitate the sale of prescription glasses.
Managed patient charts, sales reports, office inventory and stock orders.








Managed confidental medical charts while performing optometic testing and customer support.
Improved patient re-call system to increase business revenue.








Coached and assisted students on the classroom floor and in 1-on-1 lessons.
Created lesson plans and personalized curriculums tailored to individual student needs
